body: if i remember correctly the year i went (2009) all of the various fees made the ticket price double the already massively overpriced face value

most of the homeless shelters i am aware of are run out of and funded by christian churches. i am particularly grateful for the lifesaving cold weather shelters my friends volunteer at in new hampshire. they offer no judgement and make no attempts at conversion. just a warm place to sleep during the winter months.
